name: Yabuki Yuki
source:
A former student model now a member of the idol unit "Charm" and Yura's older twin sister.
Since they were young she has always been bullying and tormenting Yura but she in fact has a huge brother complex. Because she didn't want to go too far and become hated by him she left home and became an idol to put distance between them.
